fieldData.awb---integration-feature-1:
Visits left drop to 3, and her therapist gets an email

Once the call to the plan ends, the Tillbrook Physical Therapy front desk fills in the staff section for Sunniva Holt. She has a $30 copay, $250 of deductible left, and 17 of 20 visits used this year. With 3 visits left, the app emails her therapist, Imani Brooke, before another session goes on the calendar.
fieldData.acrm---integration-feature-4:
At 3 p.m., Slack gets every unverified scan

Tomorrow's schedule at Pell Street Imaging has 24 scans, and 21 are verified. At 3 p.m. the app posts the other 3 to the #scheduling Slack channel. One is an MRI marked as needing prior authorization, with no authorization number on file yet, and a scheduler picks it up before the end of the day.
fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { dentalOffices: "My dental office sends every new patient an insurance form when they book. Ask for the plan name, member ID, group number, and the policyholder's name, plus photos of the front and back of the card. Save each patient's answers to a record and list it for the front desk as ready to verify.", physicalTherapy: "Our physical therapy clinic calls each patient's plan before the first visit. Give the front desk a staff section for the copay, deductible left, visits allowed this year, visits used, and the call reference number. When a patient has 3 visits left, email their therapist.", counseling: "Our counseling practice sees teens covered on a parent's plan. Ask whether the patient is the policyholder, and if the answer is no, open a section for the policyholder's name, date of birth, employer, and relationship to the client. End with a typed signature confirming the details.", imagingCenters: "I run scheduling at an imaging center. Track tomorrow's scans with a verified or open status, plus prior authorization status and number for each one. At 3 p.m. every day, post any scan that is still open to our #scheduling Slack channel, with what is missing." };
fieldData.afb---prompt: Build an insurance verification form that saves every response to a database I own.
